{{/* The featured book: the hero content block's pick (site.json hero.book, a slug) when present and published, else the newest publication_date across data/books.json. Usage: $featured := partial "featured-book.html" . */}} {{- $pick := "" -}} {{- with hugo.Data.site.hero -}} {{- with .book -}} {{- $pick = index (where hugo.Data.books.books "slug" .) 0 -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $sorted := sort hugo.Data.books.books "publication_date" "desc" -}} {{- return $pick | default (index $sorted 0) -}}
